verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is built for background delegation. Bots run on a persistent cloud computer that keeps working while your laptop is closed, and you set up a job just by describing it. The docs show multi-step task examples (investigating latency, building and deploying a site, reproducing and filing a bug), and you can review results, approve steps, and edit drafts before they are sent, from desktop or mobile. Independent users confirm the async work "actually works": one bot negotiated with about 40 suppliers on its own, and a month-long user describes the delegation model as natural. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the Bot notifies you when a delegated task is done and ready for review.
